scenes.say: Ever wonder why Spark jobs slow down? Let’s talk partitioning and how to handle skew.

scenes.label: Partitioning
scenes.sub: Splits data across tasks for parallelism.
scenes.say: Partitioning splits your data across tasks. It’s key for parallel processing and performance.
Use repartition to increase or decrease partitions with a shuffle. Coalesce only reduces them, skipping a full shuffle.
To handle skew, I check the Spark UI for uneven partitions, salt keys to spread data out, or repartition before joins.

scenes.question: When should you use coalesce?
scenes.right: To efficiently reduce partitions without a full shuffle
scenes.say: Don’t say coalesce when you want more partitions. It only reduces them, and skips a full shuffle.
